signal: Advanced Solutions International received a growth investment from Incline Equity Partners and iMIS was named G2 Leader for the 8th straight year

email.body1:
Jake, saw ASI just took a growth investment from Incline Equity while iMIS landed G2 Leader for the eighth year running.

New capital usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where good pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jake, quick follow-up for ASI.

After an investment like that, the pipeline target tends to jump ahead of what headcount can cover. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ASI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jake, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jake, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a fresh growth investment is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to ASI either way.
